bullets: Added FutureSearch deep research to the web-search tool, routing through a new deep-research API facade that forwards research effort, directions, and context.
Added Meta Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor as a Web and Cloud only model, correcting its rate limit to 150 RPM and 3,000,000 TPM.
Added sponsored proposal cards and controls to the CLI terminal transcript, driven by a shared view model and exposing a four-item channel menu.
Changed DeepSeek V4 Flash to the default Freebuff model for new CLI, Web and Cloud sessions, replacing GLM 5.3 Flash.
Changed the free limited-region daily session base from 3 back to 6 for level-0 free sessions.
Expanded ad fetch log fields with opportunity id, policy version, first party arm bucket and eligibility census data.
Fixed GLM 5.3 Flash reasoning ladder by restoring max and pinning the wire default to max effort.
Improved house ad fallback defaults and clarified production campaign frequency cap behavior.
Introduced house leg eligibility check and telemetry for campaign COD-358 based on user id, geo tier and a dark-deploy flag.
Made the free subscription disclaimer window dynamic, widening from 5 to 7 days.
Pinned house ad suppression for entitled subscribers so they no longer see subscription promotional messages.
Replaced per-request UUIDs with a sticky first party arm salt to keep users bucketed consistently across ad auctions.
Removed Sticky first party arm salt and reverted per-request UUIDs, rolling back COD-369 experiment.
Removed the Solar Pro 4 count cap, keeping its $0.50 per session spend ceiling and updating the tier change notice text.
Rewrote the researcher-web system prompt to drop the research true path, leaving standard web search and read url.
Stopped rolling back the sticky first party arm salt experiment for house ad suppression.
Added the sponsored run token 24-hour TTL constant to keep local jobs report valid after offline pauses.
Added disposable email domains list as an exported function for server-side blacklist seeding.
Added ad click id header and cookie constants to carry house ad clicks through Stripe checkout with HMAC verification.
Added AD statement descriptor suffix FREEBUFF.COM for one-off card charges on the Codebuff Stripe account.
Gitignored the scratch directory used by the intent-batch orchestrator to block resume state from being committed.
Clarified house ad fallback defaults and corrected documentation on campaign serving constraints.
Changed the planner or build path fallback model to MiMo for the limited tier in Cloud builds.
